hero.sub: CallMeIE is an AI phone receptionist for Cork businesses, built up the road in Munster. It answers your phone 24/7 in a natural Irish accent, books appointments straight into your diary, and texts back every missed caller within a minute. Tuned for the way Cork callers actually speak.

sections.title: A Munster neighbour, tuned for the Cork accent
sections.dek: CallMeIE is built and run from Limerick — the same province, an hour up the road — and the voice system is tuned to understand a strong Cork accent rather than ask callers to repeat themselves.
sections.body: A customer ringing a Douglas dental practice, a Ballincollig garage, or a city-centre salon off Patrick Street expects the phone to be answered — and when it rings out at lunchtime or after closing, most of them don't leave a voicemail. They ring the next business on the list. CallMeIE covers that line every hour of every day, in a natural Irish accent, and it's tuned to handle a genuine Cork accent without bouncing the caller to a menu. It serves businesses across Cork city, Douglas, Ballincollig, Mahon, Carrigaline and the wider county. Built and operated in-house from Limerick — a Munster neighbour, not an offshore call centre — with caller data never sold on.

sections.title: What it handles for a Cork business
sections.dek: Six jobs, one system, working the hours a Cork front desk can't. Not a generic chatbot — a receptionist that happens to be software.
sections.body:
I — Answer

Answers every call, 24/7

Lunchtime, after closing, weekends, bank holidays — covered. Callers get a real conversation, not a voicemail beep, so they book instead of ringing a competitor.

II — Book

Books into your diary

Reads your Google Calendar live, quotes a real slot, confirms the appointment — no double-booking, no "we'll call you back".

III — Text back

Missed-call text-back (60s)

Any call that still rings out gets an SMS within a minute offering to book or answer a quick question. No Cork lead goes cold.

IV — Qualify

Takes the details that matter

Name, number, reason, urgency — captured every time and waiting for you, instead of a half-remembered note.

V — Escalate

Forwards the urgent ones

Genuinely urgent calls route straight to your mobile, with an SMS summary at the same time. You set the rules.

VI — Report

Monday morning summary

A plain email each Monday: calls taken, appointments booked, missed-call recoveries, top questions this week. Ninety seconds.

sections.title: Built for Ireland, not for "UK & Ireland"
sections.dek: The specifics that come up on a real Cork call. Generic global-AI receptionists fail on every line in this list.
sections.body:
• Cork & Munster accentsTuned and tested against real Irish caller recordings. A strong Cork accent is understood, not routed to "press 9 for English".
  • 021 & mobile formatsHandles 021 landlines and 085/086/087/089 mobiles interchangeably — no rejected numbers.
  • Bank holidaysSt Patrick's Day, Easter Monday, the May/June/August bank holidays, October, Christmas and St Stephen's Day — auto-respects your closure calendar.
  • GDPRCall data processed under a Data Processing Agreement, EU infrastructure, recordings deleted on a fixed schedule. Caller data is never sold.
  • Keep your numberWe sit behind your existing 021 line via call forwarding — your customers ring the number already on your card and Google listing.
  • Gaeilge availableOpt-in bilingual greeting and booking for businesses that want it.
